name: The Null Minute — Feed Silence Cascade, 2203
creator: Attributed to the pseudonymous organizer 'Aseye Blank,' identity never confirmed
description: At exactly 14:00 on the 14th of March 2203, an estimated 2.3 million Meridian residents simultaneously suppressed all outgoing BCI signal for exactly sixty seconds — no feed activity, no biometric transmission, no location ping. The resulting 'dead zone' in corponation surveillance infrastructure caused cascade errors across seventeen monitoring systems and briefly convinced Axiom's automated security apparatus that a mass medical emergency was occurring. The silence was the message: we can disappear together.
medium: BCI, collective action, neural feed coordination
cultural_impact: The Null Minute demonstrated that coordinated BCI silence was a form of political speech, establishing a precedent for 'signal strikes' and inspiring the broader Unclocked movement's tactical vocabulary around feed refusal as protest.
controversy: Three participants in Tier 1 medical wards flatlined monitoring systems during the silence, causing genuine emergency response failures; two deaths were later attributed to delayed response. The organizer 'Aseye Blank' was charged in absentia with negligent homicide, charges that were never served.
story_hooks: Someone has identified 'Aseye Blank' and is sitting on the information — the question is what they want for it.
A character was one of the two people who died during the Null Minute's medical response failure; their family has never stopped looking for the organizer.
A second, larger Null Minute is being planned — but this time the corponations are ready, and the coordination channel has been infiltrated.
